# @danixsoft/hooks

@danixsoft/hooks is a zero-dependency, tree-shakeable, and SSR-safe React hooks library for modern applications. It provides 42+ highly optimized hooks for State, DOM, Sensors, and UI flows.

@danixsoft/hooks is built and maintained by DanixSoft (https://www.danixsoft.com).

## Hooks Signatures
- `useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): readonly [T, (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => void]`
- `useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T`
- `useToggle(initialValue?: boolean): readonly [boolean, () => void, () => void, () => void]`
- `usePrevious<T>(value: T): T | undefined`
- `useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>, handler: (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => void): void`
- `useForm<TValues extends Record<string, any>>({ initialValues, validate, onSubmit, }: UseFormOptions<TValues>): {`
- `usePagination<T>(data: T[], itemsPerPage: number): {`
- `useInfiniteScroll<T extends HTMLElement>(callback: () => void, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): RefObject<T>`
- `useFetch<T = unknown>(url: string, options?: RequestInit): FetchState<T>`
- `useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean`
- `useOnScreen<T extends Element>(ref: RefObject<T>, rootMargin?: string): boolean`
- `useWindowSize(): WindowSize`
- `useBoolean(defaultValue?: boolean): UseBooleanReturn`
- `useCounter(initialValue?: number, options?: UseCounterOptions): UseCounterReturn`
- `useMap<K, V>(initialState?: Iterable<readonly [K, V]>): [Omit<Map<K, V>, 'set' | 'clear' | 'delete'>, MapActions<K, V>]`
- `useCopyToClipboard(): [CopiedValue, CopyFn]`
- `useDocumentTitle(title: string): void`
- `useEventListener<K extends keyof WindowEventMap>(eventName: K, handler: (event: WindowEventMap[K]) => void, element?: undefined, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions): void`
- `useEventListener<K extends keyof HTMLElementEventMap, T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(eventName: K, handler: (event: HTMLElementEventMap[K]) => void, element: React.RefObject<T>, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions): void`
- `useEventListener<K extends keyof DocumentEventMap>(eventName: K, handler: (event: DocumentEventMap[K]) => void, element: Document, options?: boolean | AddEventListenerOptions): void`
- `useInterval(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void`
- `useTimeout(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void`
- `useCountdown(initialCount: number, options?: UseCountdownOptions): {`
- `useHover<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T | null>, boolean]`
- `useIntersectionObserver(elementRef: RefObject<Element | null>, { threshold, root, rootMargin, freezeOnceVisible, }?: Args): IntersectionObserverEntry | undefined`
- `useIsClient(): boolean`
- `useIsMounted(): () => boolean`
- `useIsomorphicLayoutEffect: typeof useEffect`
- `useSessionStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): readonly [T, (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => void]`
- `useScript(src: string): UseScriptStatus`
- `useScrollLock(lock?: boolean): void`
- `useUnmount(callback: () => void): void`
- `useUpdateEffect(effect: EffectCallback, deps?: DependencyList): void`
- `useOnlineState(): boolean`
- `useGeolocation(options?: PositionOptions): GeolocationState`
- `useAudio(src: string): {`
- `useMutationObserver(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, callback: MutationCallback, options?: MutationObserverInit): void`
- `useEvent<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: T): T`
- `useCookie(cookieName: string): readonly [string | null, (newValue: string, days?: number) => void, () => void]`
- `useScreen(): Screen | null`
- `useClickAnyWhere(handler: (event: MouseEvent) => void): void`
- `useMouse(ref?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>): MouseState`
- `useStep(maxStep: number): [number, UseStepActions]`
- `useTouch(ref?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>): TouchState`
- `useSwipe(ref?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, threshold?: number): SwipeState`
- `useWindowScroll(): [ScrollState, (y: number, x?: number) => void]`
